the electric field intensity in crystallizing polymets is a function of the gradient of temperature.
thermal-origin electric fields are a common feature of polymer crystallization.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the thermal origin of electric field in a crystallizing system is a result of inhomogeneity of the temperature field, and that the intensity of the field depends on the gradient of the temperature.
